content:
The image shows a banana plant with leaves clustered/bunched tightly at the top, appearing more upright and narrower than normal, with yellow leaf margins visible on some leaves. The plant has a stunted "rosette" appearance with leaves crowded at the apex — this is the classic presentation of Banana Bunchy Top Virus (BBTV).

```json
{"prediction": "Bunchy_Top", "confidence": 0.9, "reasoning": "Banana plant exhibits the hallmark bunchy-top symptoms: leaves crowded/rosetted at the apex, becoming progressively narrower and more upright, with yellow chlorotic margins. The stunted growth habit and bunched leaf arrangement are diagnostic of BBTV rather than the lesion-based diseases (Sigatoka, Cordana, Anthracnose) or vascular wilt (Panama)."}
```
